programme.desc: Un hombre habla sobre el infierno que vivió con la desaparición de su esposa, pues no solo sufría por ella al no saber donde estaba, también tuvo que lidiar con el hecho de que se convirtió en el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Edición especial: Cinco secretos, gran sacrificio
programme.desc: Entre lágrimas, un pequeño niño le confiesa a su madre adoptiva que quiere volver con su familia biológica. Estrellas latinas del Cirque du Soleil hablan sobre el cambio drástico en sus vidas tras la pandemia, pues se vieron obligadas a dejar los shows.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - En nombre del hijo
programme.desc: Una madre decide hacer lo que sea para vengar la muerte de su hijo sin pensar en las consecuencias que eso podría ocasionar.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Frontera: las rutas de la crisis
programme.desc: Una avalancha de inmigrantes abarrota la frontera y pone a prueba la capacidad del gobierno para manejar una nueva crisis humanitaria, la tensión entre ciudades fronterizas crece.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Entre Dios y el narco
programme.desc: Sacerdotes y pastores en ambos lados de la frontera tienen que enfrentar las agresiones de los cárteles de la droga, ellos cuentan los ataques a sus iglesias y albergues, algunos llevan armas de fuego bajo sus sotanas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La muerte del gurú
programme.desc: La muerte de un gurú ha generado misterio y dudas entre sus seguidores. Solo cuatro personas sobrevivieron a la tragedia del vuelo 965 y aún lidian con el dolor y el trauma.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Frontera olvidada
programme.desc: Miles de migrantes quieren pasar a la frontera para ir a Panamá, buscan la manera de llegar a Estados Unidos a pesar de los peligros que tienen que enfrentar.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Anatomía de una hamburguesa
programme.desc: La hamburguesa, un delicioso alimento que cautiva a cualquiera con su delicioso sabor y preparación. Lo importante es aprender a cocinarla de la manera correcta.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desaparecidas
programme.desc: Monterrey, un lugar con muchas mujeres desaparecidas, jóvenes que salieron de sus casas y no volvieron, ahora sus padres están desconsolados y en busca de justicia.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Víctimas de la justicia
programme.desc: Una batalla legal que se extendió por años, el fiscal general de México sufrió una derrota en un caso muy importante para él. Mauro Castillo habla sobre su participación en la película 'Encanto'.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Buscando gloria
programme.desc: Una joven recuerda con dolor la historia que cambió su vida durante su carrera de boxeadora. Sofía Ramos habla sobre su sueño de ser una gran atleta y cómo volvió su sueño realidad.

programme.title: Cuidado con el Ángel Capítulo 68
programme.desc: Lirio se encuentra ya en labor de parto, Leopardo trata de salvarla a ella y a su bebé. Cecilia tiene un mal presentimiento y piensa que Marichuy se encuentra en gran peligro. Ivette es sorprendida por Onelia en la habitación de Viviana.

programme.title: Triunfo del Amor Capítulo 68
programme.desc: La policía encuentra un testigo que afirma que Linda fue asesinada. Los fantasmas de sus crímenes persiguen a Bernarda. Una vecina cree haber visto a Juanjo, así que Nati y Max salen a buscarlo y lo encuentran entre los indigentes.

programme.title: El Color de la Pasión Capítulo 68
programme.desc: Alonso le cuenta a Lucía que se irá de la casa cuando ella se case con Marcelo. Rebeca descubre que Nora trató de suicidarse y culpa a Alonso.

programme.title: En Nombre del Amor Capítulo 68
programme.desc: Romina y Aron planean como separar a Emiliano de Paloma. Carlota busca los papeles importantes. Cristóbal decide quedarse de sacerdote. Bermúdez le dice a Paloma que está dispuesto a pagarle los estudios en la Ciudad de México.

programme.title: Si Nos Dejan Capítulo 68
programme.desc: Miranda crea una campaña para ayudar a las personas que han sufrido de bullying. Julieta descubre que está embarazada. Sergio le reclama a Mujica por haber dejado que Martín saliera de la cárcel.

programme.title: La mujer del vendaval Capítulo 68
programme.desc: Severo se da cuenta que alguien entró a su cuarto y se robó el collar de Nisa. Mauro le reclama a Octavia por llevar a Lencho al hotel. Christian le avisa a Alessandro que Luciano buscará apoyo para eliminarlo de la sociedad del Toscana.

programme.title: Alborada Capítulo 68
programme.desc: Gasca interroga a Marina acerca de Victoria y Sara, Marcos la defiende y se pelean a golpes. Hipólita va a visitar a Luis a casa de Cristóbal y le pide que se recupere porque Rafael y ella lo necesitan.

programme.title: De Que Te Quiero, Te Quiero Capítulo 68
programme.desc: Rodrigo comienza a usurpar el lugar de Diego para vengarse por el tiempo que estuvo en coma. Natalia comienza a sospechar que Diego le está mintiendo.

programme.title: Alborada Capítulo 69
programme.desc: Cristóbal le cuenta a Isabel que Luis está muy herido, ella le dice que puso el palacio a su nombre porque siempre será su sobrino. Marcos le cuenta a Felipe que Gasca dijo que quizás Luis no regrese y creen que fue él que trató de matarlo.

programme.title: De Que Te Quiero, Te Quiero Capítulo 69
programme.desc: Karina se entera que Irene viajó a Nueva York y decide buscar a Alonso para tratar de conquistarlo. Rodrigo presiona a Natalia para tener intimidad con ella. Eleazar le pide a una mujer seducir a Paolo, pero su plan no funciona.

programme.title: Cuidado con el Ángel Capítulo 69
programme.desc: Ivette y Viviana tienen un desafortunado enfrentamiento que termina en tragedia. Juan Miguel desenmascara a Ivette con sus intenciones. El Piraña y El Zopilote, espían a Lirio para robar a su bebé recién nacido.

programme.title: Triunfo del Amor Capítulo 69
programme.desc: Juanjo se reúne con Doña Milagros. Bernarda llama a María para hablarle de su madre. Osvaldo se despide de Max y le pide que cuide a su madre y a su hermana, que luche por su felicidad, por María y que acabe con la farsa de su matrimonio.

programme.title: El Color de la Pasión Capítulo 69
programme.desc: Milagros le reclama a Marcelo por no contarle que se casará con Lucía. Nora contesta el teléfono celular de Rebeca y cree que tiene un amante al escuchar la voz de un hombre.

programme.title: En Nombre del Amor Capítulo 69
programme.desc: Le informan a Samuel que Romina y Camila lo están buscando. Sin saber Paloma le entrega los papales de Macarena a Carlota, ella los quema y Rufina recoge los pedazos. Emiliano le propone a Paloma que se casen para irse de Real del Monte.

programme.title: Fuego en la Sangre Capítulo 104
programme.desc: Fernando se roba a la hija de Sofía y Juan trata de detenerlo antes de que la mate. Gabriela le hace creer a todos que fue Juan quien se robó a la niña. Fernando le dispara a Juan y cae en la cascada.

programme.title: Fuego en la Sangre Capítulo 105
programme.desc: Sarita y Jimena le dicen a Eva que aunque no pueden perdonarla, dejarán que se acerque a Sofía. Sofía sufre por no poder encontrar a su hija. Leonora se encuentra en el monte con su campaña de vacunación.

programme.title: Tres Veces Ana Capítulo 57

programme.title: Tres Veces Ana Capítulo 59

programme.title: Tres Veces Ana Capítulo 60

programme.desc: María avisa en casa que Fernando está en el hospital. Luis Fernando busca al dueño del casino, le reclama por cobrarle a su padre, el dueño saca un arma y le dispara.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 424
programme.desc: León influye en los directivos de la escuela para expulsar a Roberta. Diego decide dejar la banda para proteger a Roberta de su papá. Mía se siente orgullosa de Franco y le pregunta si Miguel algún día abrirá los ojos.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 425
programme.desc: Roberta, Diego y Martín Reverte arman un plan para que León sea encarcelado por los fraudes que cometió, pero León los descubre y lo impide. Alma le comunica a León que un amigo de ella tiene información comprometedora sobre él.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 426
programme.desc: Alma le exige a León que reincorporen a Roberta y al profesor Reverte al colegio a cambio de unos papeles que lo comprometen. Madariaga informa a los muchachos que si Miguel entra en un estado crítico y despierta puede tener daño cerebral.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 427
programme.desc: Diego le deja en claro a León que puede cuidarse solo y no necesita de su dinero. Mía cuida a Miguel mientras se encuentra en coma, cuando él abre los ojos no la reconoce. José finalmente lee la carta que le dejó Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 428
programme.desc: Miguel despierta del coma, pero no recuerda nada, excepto a Diego. Diego intenta ayudar a Miguel para que recuerde sin éxito alguno. Mía se altera mucho porque Miguel no la recuerda. Los alumnos comienzan a buscar universidad.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 429
programme.desc: Vico le dice a Celina que Giovanni ya sabe sobre la prueba de embarazo, algo que les preocupa a ambas, ya que no quieren que nadie sepa. Marina intenta saber quién le llamó misteriosamente al hotel y llama al celular de Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 430
programme.desc: Todos se enteran de que Celina está embarazada. Alma habla con la mamá de Mía y Franco se enoja por meterse en sus asuntos. Mía piensa seguir los consejos de Alma y Lupita en torno a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 431
programme.desc: Celina no sabe qué hacer con su bebé, se siente muy sola porque Max se fue y el profesor Madariaga la aconseja. Sol se entera del embarazo y chantajea a Celina. Alma no cree en las intenciones de Marina de no acercarse a Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 432
programme.desc: Celina asiste a su primera cita médica. Marina le pide perdón a Franco por haberlo abandonado. Miguel le pide a Mía que lo ayude a recordar sobre su novia, pero él cree que su novia es Sabrina. Diego es despedido del trabajo por culpa de su padre.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 433
programme.desc: Mía no perdona a Franco por mentirle toda su vida sobre el presunto fallecimiento de su madre. Miguel no acepta hacer la rehabilitación y Franco habla con él. Javier es inculpado en el robo de tangas y calzones a las alumnas de Elite Way School.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 434
programme.desc: Gandía le confiesa a Madariaga la situación en torno a los cheques. Mía informa a sus amigas que su mamá no está muerta. Roberta y Diego sacan a Miguel del hospital, él les pide que le hablen sobre la relación con Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 435
programme.desc: Mía pone un anuncio en el periódico para encontrarse con su mamá. Sol acude al desfile de modas, sin embargo, nada de lo que esperaba sale a la perfección. Miguel regresa a clases para que eso lo ayude a recordar, Mía se altera mucho al verlo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 436
programme.desc: Roberta termina con Diego porque se está dejando comprar por León. Marina le confiesa a Mía el por qué de su abandono y después le cancela la cita que tenían pactada. Miguel regresa al colegio y les pide a sus amigos ayuda para hablar con Mía.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.desc: All across America hunters kick off the fall hunting season with a weekend of doves, friends, and food. Steve's lifelong friend, Ronny Boehme has invited Steve out to his digs in Virginia for the dove opener. To prep for opening day, Steve and Ron spend a day brushing up on their shooting skills on a sporting clays course followed by a pigeon hunt. Steve shares simple, delicious cooking methods for doves and pigeons.

programme.title: MeatEater

programme.desc: Ryan Callaghan and Aaron Evans join Steve on an epic adventure in British Columbia's Rockies to pursue grizzly bears. Steve has long desired to take a grizzly but only if he can do it in a way that fits his personal ethics. The hunt is dampened by frustrating weather but Steve finds a way to fix a tasty meal.

programme.title: MeatEater

programme.desc: Steve's quest for a giant mule deer buck continues in central Idaho. To help Steve in his journey, Ryan Callaghan has offered up one of his best spots as well as his keen spotting skills. The duo backpack hunt in some of the West's steepest and prettiest mountains seeking the colossal buck of Steve's dreams. In part two Steve finds the buck he's been searching for his whole life. The dream is realized and Steve and Ryan feast on a slow cooked roast.

programme.sub-title: MeatEater - El Venado Blanco: Mexico Coues Deer
programme.desc: Steven Rinella returns to his favorite hunting grounds of Sonora, Mexico to hunt for a Coues deer buck during the peak rutting season. Steve sets up camp and spends days glassing mountains and canyons for these elusive, wary desert whitetails. Meanwhile, his hunting partner, Remi Warren, attempts the difficult task of stalking one with a bow. To cap off the hunt, Steve cooks a batch of venison ribs braised in a Dutch oven buried beneath hot coals.

programme.desc: Janis Putelis of MeatEater reunites with his father on their family property in south central Wisconsin.

programme.desc: Steven Rinella heads to Wisconsin to spend a few days on his buddys historical family farm to hunt small game.

programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Cooking Special: Butchering a Whole Deer
programme.desc: In this Cooking Special, Steve demonstrates how to butcher a whole whitetail deer.

programme.sub-title: MeatEater - A Trip of Firsts: Mexico Coues Deer
programme.desc: Steve and Janis head into the remote mountains of Sonora, Mexico, to pursue the elusive Coues deer.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Trapped in History: Wyoming Beaver
programme.desc: Steven Rinella heads to the historic beaver trapping grounds of Wyoming to explore the legacy of the mountain man era. As he sets traps along the Green River, Steve immerses himself in the methods and stories of early American trappers. Alongside his quest to catch beavers, he delves into the fascinating history of how beavers shaped the fur trade and American frontier life. It's a journey through both the rugged landscapes and the rich heritage of the American West.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Conservation History, New Mexico Turkey
programme.desc: Steven Rinella and ecologist Karl Malcolm head to the Cibola National Forest, guided by a century-old tip from conservationist Aldo Leopold, to hunt Merriam's wild turkeys. Their adventure showcases the forest's rich history and the legacy of Leopold's conservation efforts while they track these elusive birds through challenging terrain.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Cooking Special: Smoked Meats With Eduardo Garcia
programme.desc: Steven Rinella learns new culinary tricks from Chef Eduardo Garcia, a wild game enthusiast from Charged Film & Montana Mex. As Eduardo shares his expertise in smoking meats and preparing wild game dishes, Steve takes notes, eager to expand his culinary repertoire and bring fresh flavors to his own wild game cooking adventures.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Lone Star Pork: Texas Hog
programme.desc: Steven Rinella joins ranch manager and wildlife biologist Ben Binnion in Texas to explore the often-overlooked aspects of hog management. During the annual pig roundup, Steve learns about the ecological impact and challenges of controlling the hog population, providing a deeper understanding of the complexities of hunting and wildlife management in the Lone Star State.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Mountain Memories: Montana Black Bear
programme.desc: Steven Rinella heads deep into Montana's rugged mountains to hunt black bears, reflecting on two decades of memories in this harsh yet captivating landscape. Joined by memories of his brother and their youthful adventures, Steve navigates grizzly country, contemplates the passage of time, and explores the evolving nature of hunting. Through encounters with both bears and the terrain, Steve seeks not just game but a connection to the past and the lessons it holds.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Living Off the Water: Kentucky Fishing
programme.desc: Steven Rinella joins his friend Kevin Murphy on a unique fishing adventure along the Mississippi and Ohio.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Nevada Mule Deer with Joe Rogan
programme.desc: Steven Rinella teams up with Joe Rogan in Nevada's high desert to bowhunt for elusive mule deer bucks. Surrounded by vast public lands and rugged terrain, they navigate the challenges of close-range stalking with their bows. With Joe's enthusiasm for archery and Steve's experience, the duo pushes their limits in pursuit of these wary deer, embracing the highs and lows of hunting in one of America's most unforgiving landscapes.

programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and Steve Rodger fish out of Key West for tunas and sailfish while battling big seas and big sharks.

programme.title: Into The Blue

programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve start the season with Capt. Scott Stoky chasing Islamorada Tunas and Mahis offshore out of Plantation Boat Mart.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve catch a mixed bag bottom fishing off of Islamorada with Captain Scott Stoky.

programme.title: Into The Blue

programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve go yellow tailing out of Hawks Cay for a limit of tasty yellowtail snapper and Steve picks a battle with a big lemon shark.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.sub-title: Into The Blue - "Reef Fishing Out Of Hawks Cay"
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve bounce around the reefs out of Hawks Cay catching a wide variety of reef dwellers.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve take their brand new Invincible 36’ out of Plantation Boat Mart to fly the kites for some early season sailfishing.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "2 Giant Bucks In 3 Days| Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: When you're hot, you're hot! Ben McDonald goes on what might possibly be the best 3 or 4 day run of bow hunting during the rut in the Midwest.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This hunt tells a story in two parts. The first chapter follows Earl Peterson, Mark’s dad, as he steps into the field with one specific goal in mind. Experience, patience, and timing all play a role as the morning unfolds, setting the tone for the rest of the adventure. The second chapter shifts to Mark’s turn. On the coldest morning of the trip so far, the team heads into black-faced impala country. Wind, shifting conditions, and sharp eyes keep things interesting as they cover ground and look for the right opportunity. Every move matters, and nothing comes easy.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: The Journey Within - "South America Upland Slam - Entre Rios"
programme.desc: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. With flocks of pigeons and doves filling the skies, Mark is set for a fast-paced, action-packed finish to his hunt—a perfect end to an unforgettable adventure.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Meredith learns the value of the Trash Can Slam on a flounder trip with Capt. Justin that turns into a multi-species challenge.”

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt Justin Leake and Meredith McCord divert attention from what’s not happening with the tarpon bite to using CoastMaster, light tackle and experience to find snapper success on heavily fished public spots.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Everything is bigger in Texas, including the stories. With the whitetail rut in the midwest winding down, the Winchester Life Crew of Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Nikki Boxler and Paul Sawyer head south to the Texas Panhandle with Winchesters in hand hoping to wrangle in a few Texas-sized giants.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc:
In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells.
As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.sub-title: Behind The Draw - "Elk Frenzy! Bowhunting Elk In The Missouri River Breaks!"
programme.desc: The Missouri River Breaks of Montana is an amazing place to hunt elk that we are no stranger to. Nate & Clayton both drew tags and couldn’t wait to get to Flatwillow Creek Outfitters for what would be Clayton’s first elk hunt in almost 20 years.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: Hunting Land Man - "Two More Turkeys Down in Mississippi!!!"
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.sub-title: 200 - "Dream Season: Adam's Epic Boone and Crockett Double P2."
programme.desc: For veteran hunter Adam Hays, last season was unlike any other. After years of pursuing trophy whitetails, he accomplished what most hunters only dream of - taking down two record-book Boone and Crockett giants in a single season. Witness the incredible hunts that made this his most memorable year yet.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

Lynn gets a job at a small diner run by farmer Zambrini (Marc Lawrence), who harbors his own dark recipe for murder. Soon local yokels begin to disappear and Zambrini's pig farm begins to mysteriously multiply. What secrets does Zambrini hold in that pig pen? Find out when you watch Pigs, a tasty treat any home cookin' horror fan can enjoy.

programme.title: Deep Red
programme.desc: It stars David Hemmings as a musician who investigates a series of murders performed by a mysterious figure wearing black leather gloves.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: The Maniac Cop is back from the dead and stalking the streets of New York once more. Officer Matt Cordell was once a hero, but after being framed by corrupt superiors and brutally assaulted in prison, he sets out on a macabre mission of vengeance, teaming up with a vicious serial killer to track down those that wronged him and make them pay... with their lives!

programme.title: The Loch Ness Monster
programme.desc: In the arena of cryptozoology, few creatures have captured the imagination like the Loch Ness Monster. Sightings and stories of this beast of lore go back decades. Also known as Nessie for short, this creature is said to occupy Loch Ness in the Scottish Highlands and is often described as massive and long-necked. Widespread interest and belief in the Monster have increased significantly since it was brought to worldwide attention in 1933. Evidence of its presence is anecdotal, with several disputed photos and sonar examinations, but does the Loch Ness Monster really exist? Follow us as we deep dive into the facts.

programme.title: Beast from Haunted Cave
programme.desc: A giant spider stalks a band of thieves in this schlocky thriller from Gene Corman Productions. The story follows gangster Alexander Ward and his crew as they enlist the help of a local ski-instructor in the heist of several gold bars. But when they use explosives to create a distraction, they disturb the lair of a massive spider! Monte Hellman, the man behind such cult favorites as Two-Lane Blacktop, made his directorial debut with Beast From Haunted Cave. Trivia note: This movie debuted on a double bill with The Wasp Woman.

programme.title: The Deeper You Dig (Edited Version)
programme.desc: 14-year old Echo and her mother Ivy, a tarot card reader, live a quiet life in a rural area. When reclusive Kurt moves down the road to restore an abandoned farmhouse, an accident leads to Echos murder, and suddenly three lives collide in mysterious and wicked ways. Kurt assumes he can hide his secret under the ground. But Echo burrows into his head until he can feel her in his bones. As she haunts his every move, trying to reach her mother from beyond, Ivy must dig deep to see the signs and prove that love wont stay buried.

programme.title: The Innkeepers (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees -Claire (Sara Paxton) and Luke (Pat Healy)- are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels. As the Inns final days draw near, odd guests check in as the pair of minimum wage ghost hunters begin to experience strange and alarming events that may ultimately cause them to be mere footnotes in the hotels long unexplained history.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.
